name: encoding-utf16enc
algorithm: UTF-8 to UTF-16LE of a mixed-script line (ASCII, Latin-1, Cyrillic, CJK, one astral scalar) repeated n times, rounds times, each language's standard encoder; the checksum adds per round the encoding's length in bytes and one of its bytes at a moving index (README.md).

skip.c: no UTF-16 encoder in C's standard library (c16rtomb is locale-bound and one unit at a time)
skip.mk-wrap: the checksum already uses the wrapping operators; the task has no other arithmetic to wrap

no_counts: B24 does not apply: an idiomatic row compares libraries; the encoder is tested by the lane's Go tests (TestStdEncoding_DecodeAdversarial)
notes: Mk: encoding.Utf16Le.Encode into an arena reset each round (sized in one pass, written in a second: Mk's API, bytes in little-endian order). Rust: str::encode_utf16 into one Vec<u16> reused. Zig: std.unicode.utf8ToUtf16Le into one []u16 made once (an ASCII vector fast path). Go: utf16.AppendRune over the string's runes into one []uint16 reused.
Checksums: Go's at both sizes on the owner's machine (std-encoding session 2, 2026-11-12); tools/bench verify checks the other columns.
Not published: no number here is a measurement.
